description: Assembly layout of the Meca500 robot, generated from Meca500_v11.3.3.12637-official.eds by tools/eds_to_spec.py. Do not edit by hand: re-run the generator against a newer EDS instead.

motion_commands.description: Identifiers accepted in the MotionCommand field of the output assembly, keyed by command name. The EDS, the GSDML and the ESI all defer these to the programming manual, so they cannot be generated and must be filled in by hand.

input.description: Robot to scanner: cyclic robot state.
